title: ThinkingCap RTX 5090: 32K and 128K complete recipes
subtitle: 100 strict requests per whole recipe; nominal 4K/C1, 32 code words plus canary, 45 output tokens, thinking off, unique cache. Both use MTP3 and BF16 KV; configured context, weight placement and memory fraction differ. No isolated offload/context speedup claim.

metric_semantics.population: Each point is a complete, zero-failure, performance-eligible population of 100 requests.
metric_semantics.scope: Short controlled output only: 32 requested lowercase code words with a 512-token cap; do not generalize to long output, long context, reasoning, multimodal, or production concurrency.
metric_semantics.matching: 100 strict requests per whole recipe; nominal 4K/C1, 32 code words plus canary, 45 output tokens, thinking off, unique cache. Both use MTP3 and BF16 KV; configured context, weight placement and memory fraction differ. No isolated offload/context speedup claim.
metric_semantics.ttft: Client-observed request start to first non-empty visible content delta; plotted as p50 milliseconds.
metric_semantics.decode: Client-observed generation decode rate using usage completion tokens after the first token; plotted as p50 tokens per second.
metric_semantics.e2e: Client-observed end-to-end request duration; plotted as p50 milliseconds.
metric_semantics.throughput: Aggregate performance-eligible completion-token throughput in tokens per second.
metric_semantics.p99: n=100 p99 values are order statistics and must not be presented as a stable SLA; p99 is not plotted in this matrix.
